title: fix: soft_sign() does not validate sig output pointer for NULL
description:
In src/wp11_backend_soft.c, soft_sign() validates handle, handle->priv, in, and siglen — but NOT the sig output buffer pointer. wc_ecc_sign_hash() at line ~189 writes to sig without a prior NULL check.

The parallel functions soft_verify() and soft_decrypt() both check their output pointers. This is an inconsistency that will cause a null pointer dereference if the PKCS#11 layer passes a NULL sig pointer (which it legitimately does in size-query mode: C_Sign with pSignature==NULL calls the backend with sig==NULL expecting only the length back).

Trigger: C_Sign size-query call (pSignature=NULL) routed to soft backend.
Bad behavior: wc_ecc_sign_hash(in, inlen, NULL, &siglen, ...) → crash or undefined behavior.

Fix: Add at the top of soft_sign():
  if (sig == NULL) { ... return length-query path ... }
Or match the other backends: check sig != NULL for the actual signing path, return length estimate for size-query.
